concerns.text: FR-002 requires a '10–500 Hz band-pass Butterworth filter'. Task T015 description only mentions 'band-pass Butterworth filter' and '50/60 Hz notch filter' but omits the explicit '10–500 Hz' frequency range specification. While 'band-pass' is mentioned, the specific constraints required by the spec are not explicitly codified in the task description, risking implementation with incorrect cutoffs.

FR-005 requires 'nested 5-fold cross-validation'. The Plan deviates to 'Nested LOSO' (justified in Plan Deviation Log). Task T019 implements LOSO. However, FR-005 also mandates training a 'Support Vector Machine (linear kernel)'. T019 implements 'Random Forest' and 'Logistic Regression' (per Plan Dual Model Strategy) but makes NO mention of the SVM required by FR-005. The SVM requirement is effectively dropped without a corresponding task to either implement it or explicitly document its removal in the task list.

FR-005 and Plan require 'window-level prediction aggregation via majority voting'. Task T021 is marked as incomplete (checkbox empty) and lacks a description. Without this task, the subject-level aggregation logic required to satisfy the Plan's 'Subject-Level Aggregation' constraint and FR-005's subject-level splitting is missing.

FR-005 requires training a Random Forest. The Plan requires a 'Dual Model Strategy' (RF + LogReg). Task T022 is marked incomplete and lacks a description. It is critical for saving the 'model_bundle.pkl' containing both models. Without this task, downstream tasks (T026, T027, T029) cannot load the required models, breaking the implementation of FR-006, FR-007, and SC-002.

FR-008 requires a 'permutation test (1000 shuffles)' and 'paired t-test'. Task T023 is marked incomplete and lacks a description. It is the primary validation step for US1. Without it, SC-001 (statistical significance) cannot be verified for the core pipeline.

All implementation tasks for User Story 2 (T026-T029, T031) and tests (T024-T025) are marked incomplete (checkboxes empty) and lack descriptions. This leaves FR-006 (Permutation/SHAP), FR-007 (Nagelkerke's R²), and SC-002 (Variance Explanation) without any assigned implementation work.

All implementation tasks for User Story 3 (T034-T039) and tests (T032-T033) are marked incomplete (checkboxes empty) and lack descriptions. This leaves FR-008 (Permutation/T-test), FR-009 (Sensitivity), SC-003 (Robustness), SC-004 (Feasibility), and SC-005 (Effect Size) without assigned implementation work.

All Polish & Cross-Cutting tasks (T040a-T044) are marked incomplete. T040c (paper.md template) and T043 (quickstart validation) are critical for delivering the final report and ensuring the <6h runtime constraint (SC-004) is met. T044 (artifact hashing) is required for Constitution Principle V.
Task T015 description contains a typo: 'a **Hz/60 Hz notch filter**'. The frequency value '50' is missing before the slash. This is a writing error that could lead to implementation ambiguity.

Task T018 description references 'data/logs/exclusions.log' but the Plan and Spec Edge Cases mention 'data/processed/exclusions.log' (or similar). While T018 defines the path, the inconsistency with the Plan's implied structure (if any) or the rejection note in the Analyze report suggests a need for clarification, though T018 itself defines the path. The main issue is the task is incomplete.
